children: A British investor who bought Bitcoin in 2011 through the Britcoin exchange, later renamed Intersango, has regained access to part of his lost holdings after more than a decade. According to ChainCatcher, he had invested about 1,500 pounds, or roughly $2,000, and lost wallet access after the exchange stopped trading at the end of 2012 and went offline in early 2014.

CEL Solicitors said its sister company’s crypto tracing software identified a wallet believed to belong to an Intersango user and holding more than 5,500 BTC. The investor recovered about $45,000 worth of Bitcoin, which is now valued at about $4.5 million. The firm said other former Intersango users may also be able to recover funds if they can prove ownership.

title: British Investor Recovers Bitcoin Lost After Intersango Shutdown
